MR DK MODI, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1 - 2 MS HANSA PUNANI, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ================================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE R.M.CHHAYA  Date : 01/10/2014
ORAL ORDER Heard Mr.D.K. Modi, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Learned counsel for the petitioners pointed out that the Appellate Authority as provided under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is yet to be constituted and the petitioners are rendered remediless.
Ms.Hansa Punani, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, appears and wavies service on behalf of the respondent-State.
Ad-interim relief in terms of paragraph-9(c).
Liberty to apply for final hearing after the pleadings are over.

(R.M.CHHAYA, J.) Suchit Krishna Traders Thro.Bharatkumar ... vs State Of Gujarat & 2 on 1 October, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25621211/
